newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P puts Email on creditwatch negative.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P puts Email on creditwatch negative.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it placed the ratings of electrical consumer goods manufacturer Email Ltd on creditwatch negative.
The company has "A" long term and "A1" short-term ratings.

S&P said the company was placed on creditwatch following the release of its fiscal 1997 results which revealed continuing greater use of debt leverage to fund asset growth than had been factored into the ratings.
"Also, Standard and Poor's anticipates that low growth of an strong competition in core segments may prevent Email from restoring its prudential measures to levels consistent with an "A" rating."
Email has four core divisions -- metals, major appliances, building products, and industrial products.
